line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.original: Historical original control 2/4 failures. The original fixed 16-byte buffer includes the two-byte prefix and terminator. A 15-character name still exceeds this boundary. No live network acceptance.
verification.current: Built actual VrRemoteApi under current product flags. All four cases passed, including ASCII, accented character, capacity rejection 13 and NetAPI error 5. No transport call on either failure.

decision: R1300/R1301 retain the bounded UTF-16 to CP_ACP conversion and failure cleanup. Original NetWkstaGetInfo level 100 returns a wide name, while subsequent RtlInitAnsiString/ANSI-to-Unicode consumes the prefixed byte buffer. Direct strcpy truncates ASCII UTF-16 at the first high zero byte. Error path releases the NetAPI buffer before testing conversion and conditionally frees owned packed send data. Changing a shared return label would move equivalent cleanup and would touch other original code.
